import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

pd.set_option("future.distinguish_nan_and_na", True)

arr = pd.array([np.nan, pd.NA, 3.0], dtype="Float64")

# 1-2) astype to the pyarrow-backed string dtype
try:
    res = arr.astype("string[pyarrow]")
    pdna = sum(1 for x in res if x is pd.NA)
    rawnan = sum(1 for x in res if isinstance(x, float) and np.isnan(x))
    probe("astype_arrow_pdna_count", float(pdna))
    probe("astype_arrow_raw_nan_count", float(rawnan))
except Exception:
    probe("astype_arrow_pdna_count", float("nan"))
    probe("astype_arrow_raw_nan_count", float("nan"))

# 3-4) DataFrame.to_csv with a masked Float64 column
try:
    df = pd.DataFrame({"a": pd.array([np.nan, pd.NA, 3.0], dtype="Float64"), "b": "c"})
    rows = df.to_csv(index=False).splitlines()
    probe("to_csv_frame_row_count", float(len(rows)))
    probe("to_csv_frame_empty_a_count", float(sum(1 for r in rows[1:] if r.startswith(","))))
except Exception:
    probe("to_csv_frame_row_count", float("nan"))
    probe("to_csv_frame_empty_a_count", float("nan"))

# 5-6) Series.to_csv after a division that produces NA
try:
    ser = pd.Series((1, pd.NA, 0), index=["a", "b", "c"], dtype="Float64", name="x")
    ser = ser / ser
    rows = ser.to_csv().splitlines()
    probe("to_csv_series_row_count", float(len(rows)))
    probe("to_csv_series_last_a_empty", float(1 if rows[-1].endswith(",") else 0))
except Exception:
    probe("to_csv_series_row_count", float("nan"))
    probe("to_csv_series_last_a_empty", float("nan"))
